title: MIZAR normalized event
description: Normalized record produced from one original log record. Version 1.0.0. Fields that a source does not provide are null; parsers never invent values. The original bytes stay in the immutable evidence file at original_record_reference; formats that cannot be read back by offset (EVTX, XML/JSON/CSV exports, UTF-16 text) also keep a stored copy. Storage holds schema_version, parser_version and ingestion_time once per parse result; the API presents them on every event.

event_id.description: Stable identifier: UUIDv5 of case, source file, content hash and record locator. Re-parsing the same source file yields the same IDs.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the event conforms to.

source_file_id.description: Source file (evidence record) the original record came from.

parse_result_id.description: Parse run that produced this event (parser, version and hints used).

source_type.description: Kind of source the record came from.

parser_name.description: Parser that produced the event, e.g. linux.sshd.

record_index.description: 0-based position of the record within its source file, in parse order.

original_record_reference.description: Locator of the original record within the source file: line numbers (1-based) and byte offsets for text, the record ID for EVTX, item or row indexes for structured exports.

record_hash.description: SHA-256 of the raw record bytes. Used to find the same record collected twice.

timestamp_original.description: Timestamp exactly as written in the record.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC time, only when conversion is reliable (see timezone_assumption). Null otherwise; never guessed.

timezone_assumption.description: Basis for timestamp_utc: explicit offset in the record, UTC by format definition, analyst-supplied IANA zone, or none (timestamp_utc is null).

hostname.description: Host that generated the record, as written.

username.description: Primary subject or target account of the event, as written (case preserved). See extra for other accounts involved.

user_domain.description: Windows domain or realm of username.

source_ip.description: Validated IPv4/IPv6 address. Invalid values are null and kept in extra with an invalid_ip warning.

protocol.description: Lowercase protocol, e.g. tcp, udp, ssh, http.

event_type.description: Normalized action, e.g. logon, logon_failed, user_created, http_request, connection_denied.

event_outcome.description: Outcome as recorded by the source. Null when not applicable.

event_code.description: Native code: Windows EventID, HTTP status, auditd record type, CEF signature ID.

process_name.description: Process that logged or performed the action.

session_id.description: Key that links events of one session: Windows logon ID, sshd process, Zeek uid, auditd session.

message.description: Human-readable message as in the source, not rewritten.

extra.description: Source-specific fields not in the core schema.

parsing_status.description: parsed: all applicable fields extracted; partial: some fields could not be extracted or validated; unparsed: kept as raw only.

parse_warnings.description: Machine-readable warning codes, e.g. timestamp_unparsed, invalid_ip, year_rollover_inferred.
